subject: Recap: pilot timeline, procurement blockers & closing the loop
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmehealth.com>, Erika Gomez <erika.gomez@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 15:08:00 -0800
Subject: Recap: pilot timeline, procurement blockers & next steps

Hi Samir / Erika —

Nice to meet you both on the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have the same checklist going into procurement: 

- Scope: 6-week pilot focused on outpatient claims summarization + embeddings for retrieval-based workflows. Production-like traffic ~2k requests/day simulated.
- Deliverables: pilot deployment (Private VPC), weekly progress syncs, eval dashboard access, and a short handoff doc for your infra team.
- Timeline: target kick-off the week of Mar 9, ending Apr 20.
- Procurements/controls you asked about: SOC 2 summary, data retention options, and an IP/data usage addendum.

Action items (owners):
1) Jasmine: send pilot proposal + SOC2 summary (attached) — sent here.
2) Samir / Erika: confirm procurement cadence and any one-off legal clauses we should expect by Feb 18.
3) Ben / Marcus (cc): standby for technical handoff once procurement greenlights.

If the March 9 start doesn't work, happy to shift to a later window — would love a quick confirmation of timing so I can hold the slot on our side.

Attachments: [Attachment: redwood-pilot-proposal.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)], [Attachment: soc2-summary.pdf (PDF, 0.2MB)]

Thanks —

Jasmine Liu
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmehealth.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Erika Gomez <erika.gomez@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Feb 2026 11:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap: pilot timeline, procurement blockers & next steps

Thanks for the recap, Jasmine — appreciated.

We're interested; I shared the proposal with procurement and IT. Procurement is asking for an estimated SOW/line items and an internal approval window — they may need two weeks to route. IT is reviewing the VPC/network requirements and requested the SOC2 doc (got it).

I'll update you as soon as procurement comes back with a list of standard addenda. For now, please keep the Mar 9 slot tentatively open; I should have a clearer answer by end of next week (Feb 24).

Samir
Samir Patel
Director, Data Science | Acme Health
samir.patel@acmehealth.com | +1 617-555-9933

Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Quick bump — procurement timing for pilot (Mar 9)

Hi Samir —

Just checking in on procurement timing. You mentioned you expected to hear back by Feb 24; haven't seen an update. We still have the week of Mar 9 tentatively available but need to lock engineers soon.

Options if procurement is pushed out:
- Option A: Keep the Mar 9 slot tentatively and proceed as soon as procurement signs off. We can do a short checklist to unblock engineering in parallel.
- Option B: Move kick-off to the week of Mar 23 and extend the pilot window two weeks.

If neither is realistic, we can pause and I'll follow up in a couple weeks — or if you'd prefer, I can introduce your procurement person to our legal lead to fast-track the SOW questions.

Would you prefer I connect procurement and legal, or should we push dates?

Thanks,

Jasmine
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Direct: +1 415-555-0123

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Erika Gomez <erika.gomez@acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 09:24:00 -0800
Subject: Closing the loop — should I close the file on the Acme pilot?

Hi Samir / Erika —

Wanted to close the loop on the pilot discussion. We haven't heard back following the procurement review (I know these cycles can drag). Quick callout on next steps depending on where you are: 

- If procurement needs more time, I'm happy to leave the opportunity open and check in mid-March.
- If priorities shifted and this isn't the right quarter, say the word and I'll archive the file — no hard feelings and we can re-open anytime.

If helpful, I can also arrange a 20-minute session with our legal lead to answer procurement questions directly (SOW templates, data residency options).

If I don't hear back by EOD Mar 9, I'll assume you want me to close the file and I'll follow up later in Q2. Appreciate the transparency either way.

Best —

Jasmine Liu
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
